question: Which Amendment Act paved the way for the introduction of goods and services tax in the country?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**101st Amendment Act**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **101st Amendment Act** of the Indian Constitution was enacted in **2016** to introduce the **Goods and Services Tax (GST)** in India.
 
• It provided the legal framework for the implementation of GST, which is a **comprehensive indirect tax** levied on the manufacture, sale, and consumption of goods and services throughout India.
 
• This amendment added **Article 246A** to the Constitution, granting both the **Union and State legislatures** the power to make laws on GST.
